text:
Noah (PM): Heads-up: competitor launched a low-cost embeddings SKU and per-route SLO tiers. Sales getting pushback. Need a quick product decision: parity shim to stop churn or double-down on a differentiated quality-tier roadmap?

Diego (Sales): Trials are switching. We need something fast to keep SMB trials engaged.

Priya (Research): Data: price-sensitive cohorts convert but churn if quality mismatches. Quality labeling could reduce churn.

Aisha (Eng): Two options: (A) Parity shim: expose small-embed alias + per-route opt-in pricing flag. Fast (2 sprints). (B) Quality tiers: per-route routing + eval-driven recommendations (3 months).

Tom (Infra): Parity needs reserved pools to avoid cache thrash. Ops cost but doable.

Sam (Support): If we offer parity, provide clear migration doc and caveats to reduce support load.

Noah (PM): Proposal: ship parity shim this quarter as a defensive move, with committed parallel roadmap for quality-tier product. Vote: :+1: for shim, :thinking_face: for skip shim and accelerate tiering.

Aisha (Eng): :+1: ship shim (forward-compatible alias).

Diego (Sales): :+1: urgent.

Priya (Research): :thinking_face: prefer tiering long-term but ok for shim.

Noah (PM): Action items: Noah - spec & messaging; Aisha - dev spike for alias; Tom - infra pool plan; Priya - bench harness. Will slot shim into next sprint if no objections in 24h.
